title: Existence Precedes Value: Joint Modeling of Observational Existence and Evolving States in Time Series Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2606.13571v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Real-world time series are often highly incomplete and irregular due to sensor dormancy, transmission delays, and event-driven sampling, making reliable forecasting fundamentally challenging. Existing methods have evolved from impute-then-forecast pipelines to continuous-time models such as Neural ODEs and continuous-time graph networks. While these approaches improve the modeling of historical irregularity, they still rely on an implicit oracle assumption at inference time: the timestamps of future valid observations are presumed to be known in advance. This assumption limits practical relevance, since in many real systems the more fundamental question is not only what the future value will be, but also whether a valid observation will occur at all. In this paper, we propose Timeflies, a unified framework that reformulates forecasting as a joint problem of future observability inference and value estimation. To explicitly mode

translated_title: 存在先于价值：时间序列预测中观测存在性与演化状态的联合建模
translated_abstract: 由于传感器休眠、传输延迟和事件驱动采样等原因，现实世界的时间序列往往是高度不完整且不规则的，这使得可靠的预测从根本上充满挑战。现有方法已经从“先插补后预测”的流程发展到连续时间模型，例如神经常微分方程和连续时间图网络。虽然这些方法改进了对历史不规则性的建模，但它们在推断时仍然依赖于一个隐含的“神谕假设”：即未来有效观测的时间戳被假定为预先已知。这一假设限制了其实际应用价值，因为在许多现实系统中，更根本的问题不仅是未来的值是多少，而是未来是否会发生有效的观测。在本文中，我们提出了Timeflies，这是一个统一框架，将预测重新表述为未来可观测性推断与数值估计的联合问题。为了显式建模……
tldr: 该论文提出Timeflies统一框架，摒弃了现有方法隐含的“未来观测时间戳已知”的神谕假设，将时间序列预测重新表述为未来观测存在性推断与数值估计的联合建模问题。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes Timeflies, a unified framework that abandons the implicit oracle assumption of pre-known future observation timestamps in existing methods, reformulating time series forecasting as a joint problem of future observability inference and value estimation.
